source_table: yearly_full_release_long_format.csv: Electricity generation (Fuel, TWh), Capacity (Fuel, GW), Total generation (TWh)
unit: TWh generated; GW installed; % of generation
transformations: eight fuel categories; share_pct = generation ÷ Ember's total generation × 100
generation and capacity joined per country, year, and source
notes: CC BY 4.0. Ember is also the electricity source behind Our World in Data's energy dataset, so shares match the OWID electricity-mix charts. Canada (Ember methodology): annual generation from the Energy Institute Statistical Review; monthly generation from Statistics Canada, whose by-technology fossil total is split into coal and gas with IEA monthly fuel ratios; coal/gas/other-fossil capacity from Global Energy Monitor, other capacity from IRENA (co-firing makes the fossil capacity split imprecise).
